 Procedure
Equipment:Three Phase Motors
General Electric
Introduction

This 
document lists the equipment inspection I1, which must be carried out every 
six months as indicated by M6 in the title block

The first draft initiated by eng. Metwaly El-Hendawy, 
tested by eng. Abd El-Geid Abd El-Wahab, accepted 
by eng. Yousry Ahmed Abd El-Maksuod general director, revised by 
eng. Tawfek El-Abasery; EDEPC 
inspection and quality control, approved by eng. Fathy 
Ragab head sector of Talkha PS.

This document 
accepted by eng. Samir Abd El-Gilil, EDEPC inspection and quality controls 
general director, MPIS coordinator, and certified by accountant: Mahmoud Mohamed 
Soliman: EDEPC admin & financial inspection quality controls general director, and 
supervisor of inspection and quality controls head sector.
Safety Precautions

A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Wear safety & healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, breathing 
 mask, safety glasses etc.
Isolate the motor: electrical and mechanical.
